<!-- openqodex:start -->
## Review with OpenQodex
- When a feature or fix is done, and before any push, review it with the openqodex skill: "review my change with openqodex".
- Do not push on a blocked verdict unless the developer says so after seeing the findings.
<!-- openqodex:end -->

Before any `git push`, and whenever you are asked to review the changes, run `/home/dev/.openqodex/bin/openqodex guide skill` from the repository and follow what it prints: the review procedure of the OpenQodex version installed here.
